final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference (sinks IREF = 10 uA)
M8 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
* tail current source (60 uA)
M5 tail ibias vss vss nfet W=24 L=1
* NMOS input pair (vinp drives the out1 side -> non-inverting)
M1 x vinn tail vss nfet W=24 L=1
M2 out1 vinp tail vss nfet W=24 L=1
* PMOS mirror load
M3 x x vdd vdd pfet W=14 L=0.5
M4 out1 x vdd vdd pfet W=14 L=0.5
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink (280 uA)
M6 vout out1 vdd vdd pfet W=130 L=0.5
M7 vout ibias vss vss nfet W=112 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz out1 nz 1.7k
Cc nz vout 0.9p
.ends
